title: test(cli): drop the tsx launcher from three 10-13 s cli files, budget seven distinct floors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XHooRkTuA7b1AuVZXWN8GsL)_

Part of #23181 (slice 31). The card stays open for later slices: this one takes only the eight remaining `packages/cli` files from 10 s to 13 s in slice 23's table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`packages/cli` 里 CI 读数 10–13 s、还没有预算头的 8 个测试文件。其中 3 个原来经 `node_modules/.bin/tsx` 包装层起 CLI 源码入口，现在直接用 `process.execPath` 起同一个 `bin/run-dev.js`（参数、cwd、env、超时都不变），本地快 16%–28%。7 个文件在第 2 行加 `// test-budget: 20` 头；translation-contributed-nav 换入口后预计已在 10 s 以下，不加头。
- **为什么改**：卡 #23181 的测试提速职责：超过 10 s 的测试文件要么提速，要么按裁决 6181973363 B 声明预算。逐个数过：每个 spawn 或 doctor 运行都是不同的（命令、参数、夹具）组合，没有能合并的重复，也没有只读文件的子进程可以改成进程内读取，所以能省的只有 tsx 包装层，其余是真实工作的地板。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件，不发布任何东西（cli 的 `files[]` 只有 dist、README、CHANGELOG）；没有删、没有放宽任何断言，用例名和数量不变；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/test/create-objectstack-stack-reach.test.ts`（tsx → `process.execPath` + 头）；`packages/cli/src/commands/doctor-ledger-read-failure.test.ts`（只加头，原因写在头里）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/translation-contributed-nav-validate-door.test.ts test/i18n-extract-companion-orphan.test.ts` → 6/6 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The eight files and their slowest reading over the five scheduled `ci.yml` runs `41199450735`, `41217827347`, `41237094739`, `41255489006`, `41271604267` (slice 23's offender table: the default reporter's per-file module line in the Test Core shard logs). Local per-case readings from `--reporter=verbose`, one box, one lock hold.

| file | CI max | tests | spawns / runs | distinct triples | cause | fix |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|--:|:--|:--|
| `test/authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts` | 12.5 s (41271604267) | 11 | 3 source-CLI spawns, already on `process.execPath` | 3 | `os lint`, `os validate`, `os build` over the one planted-defect stack, in one case (7.6 s locally); the exit code is the contract, so it must be a real process. The nine rule cases run in process, 0.3 s together | header 20 |
| `test/create-objectstack-stack-reach.test.ts` | 12.4 s (41255489006) | 4 | 1 on-ramp scaffold child + 3 source-CLI spawns through the `tsx` launcher, already in one `beforeAll` | 4 | a chain over one scaffolded project: `os g object`, `os g flow --object`, `os validate`; each step reads what the last one wrote | spawn with `process.execPath`; header 20 |
| `src/commands/doctor-ledger-read-failure.test.ts` | 12.3 s (41199450735) | 27 | 15 in-process `os doctor` runs (3 on a module graph re-imported after `vi.resetModules` to swap the ledger reader) | 15 | each run shells out to `pnpm -v` (0.25–0.48 s), `tsc -v` (0.08–0.20 s) and `git --version`, and bundles its own config: 0.35–0.9 s per case, more on the first. One run per ledger fixture or flag; the fourteen row-builder cases are pure | header 20 |
| `src/commands/doctor-ledger-posture-independence.test.ts` | 12.2 s (41255489006) | 18 | 20 in-process `os doctor` runs | 20 | the same per-run cost, one run per posture × ledger fixture × flag | header 20 |
| `src/commands/doctor-node-env-default.test.ts` | 11.4 s (41271604267) | 34 | 15 in-process `os doctor` runs | 15 | the same per-run cost; the first run reads 3.0 s (the cold config-loader load). One run per `NODE_ENV` value, project shape and flag; the twenty-one row-builder cases are pure | header 20 |
| `test/i18n-extract-companion-orphan.test.ts` | 11.3 s (41271604267) | 4 | 4 source-CLI spawns through the `tsx` launcher | 4 | `os i18n extract` on the apps-only stack, its `--check` over a seeded legacy companion, and the full stack under `--objects-only` and `--no-objects-only`; each case reads the real directory its run wrote | spawn with `process.execPath`; header 20 |
| `test/hook-timeout-override-refusal.test.ts` | 11.3 s (41255489006) | 4 | 4 `vitest list` children of this package, already on `process.execPath` | 4 | `--hookTimeout`, `--teardownTimeout`, no override, `--testTimeout`: four different config-load questions (7.4 s locally) | header 20 |
| `test/translation-contributed-nav-validate-door.test.ts` | 10.5 s (41255489006) | 2 | 2 source-CLI spawns through the `tsx` launcher | 2 | `os validate --json` on the card's fixture and on its control | spawn with `process.execPath`; no header (see below) |

**Why the floor is distinct real work.** No file repeats a (command, flags, fixture) triple. The spawning files already share their setup where they can (`create-objectstack-stack-reach` in one `beforeAll`), and no child only reads a file that an in-process read could replace. In the doctor files every `Doctor.run` is its case's subject, with its own fixture, posture or flag. So seven files take the ruling 6181973363 letter B header: N = the slowest CI reading × 1.25, rounded up to 10 s (12.5, 12.4, 12.3, 12.2, 11.4, 11.3, 11.3 → 20), class `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture`. Each reason names the spawns or runs and the CI run its reading came from. All seven parse with `readTestBudget` (`scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`): line 2, 20 s, that class.

**The one lever inside the floor.** Three files spawned `bin/run-dev.js` through `node_modules/.bin/tsx`, a launcher that is its own node process in front of the CLI. They now spawn the same entry with `process.execPath`, as `authoring-rule-command-parity`, the migrate family (slice 12) and slice 25's files already do: same entry, same `src/`, same `childEnv()`, argv, cwd and timeouts. `create-objectstack-stack-reach` and `i18n-extract-companion-orphan` keep their header, because the switch projects their CI reading to about 9.3–9.5 s, inside the run-to-run spread of the 10 s line. `translation-contributed-nav-validate-door` projects to about 7.6 s, so it takes no header.

Not changed: no assertion, case name, case count, timeout, tier, project or helper. No source file, nothing under `test/helpers/**`.

## Tests

- **A/B** for the three files whose code changed. The base file (`git show ce001f97:…`) copied beside head as `test/zzbase-*.test.ts`, one box, one lock hold, N=3, each file run alone (`vitest run --maxWorkers=1 FILE`), base and head interleaved. Reading: the default reporter's per-file module line. Copies deleted before the gate run.

  | file | base (s) | head (s) | change |
  |:--|:--|:--|--:|
  | `create-objectstack-stack-reach` | 8.58, 7.73, 7.69 | 5.97, 6.15, 5.92 | −24.8% (mean 8.00 → 6.01) |
  | `translation-contributed-nav-validate-door` | 6.92, 6.67, 6.65 | 5.08, 4.92, 4.68 | −27.5% (mean 6.74 → 4.89) |
  | `i18n-extract-companion-orphan` | 7.03, 6.57, 6.53 | 5.79, 5.43, 5.68 | −16.0% (mean 6.71 → 5.64) |

  Every run exit 0, same test count per side (4, 2, 4). The CI projections above apply these ratios to the CI max.
- **Header-only files** (`authoring-rule-command-parity`, the three doctor files, `hook-timeout-override-refusal`): no A/B, per the order. Their doctor-run counts were read by instrumenting a throwaway copy of each file (deleted): 15, 20, 15.
- **All eight on head**, one run with `test/vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts`: 9 files, 126/126 passed; the tier partition pin is green, so the three edited files stay in `integration`.
- **cli unit tier** (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`, which holds the three doctor files and `hook-timeout-override-refusal`): 362/362 files, 5155/5155 tests, on the pre-merge head `0877f01c` and again on `8b3bf663`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc and `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0 on `0877f01c` and on `8b3bf663`, with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (test-only).

## Acceptance notes

- **Doctor's tool probes are most of each doctor file.** Every `Doctor.run` spawns `pnpm -v` and `tsc -v` (and `git --version`), and the three files make 50 runs between them. Memoising those probes in a test would make 47 of the runs read a probe they did not take, and every case asserts the report's gauge line, which those probes feed, so it is not a test-only lever. Noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
- **`skip-changeset`.** Test-only. `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; its build emits no `*.test.ts` into `dist/`. No `files[]` content changes.

## Verification

All readings on head `8b3bf663`: the two commits `32ad4161` (the `process.execPath` switch) and `0877f01c` (the seven headers), plus one merge of `origin/main` after slices 24 (#28610), 25 (#28601) and 26 (#28599) landed, as the order asks. The merge touches none of the eight files. The A/B above was taken on `32ad4161`.

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 52 families (the same 52 before and after the merge), each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, after a full `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (118 tasks, exit 0). All 52 exit 0 on `8b3bf663`. `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 52 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 52 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. On the pre-merge head, before the full build, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` read exit 3 (no full build), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 (its pinned fixture commit absent from the shallow clone, fetched), and `check:type-check-debt` exit 3 (its closure build lost the lock queue to my own build); each read exit 0 once its prerequisite was met.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0; `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.

- **Hand gates:** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the eight files exit 0, and `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js packages/cli --no-inline-config` (the repo `lint` script scoped to the touched package) exit 0.
- **CI** families (Test Core with the cli integration tier, lint farm, type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
